cooldown.quote: {{tt|{{pp|10 to 0 for 3|1;6;11}}|Starts after completing the channel}}
cooldown.binNote: ddragon/YuumiW lists cooldown 0 (the ability's base data cooldown field is unused since the true cooldown is level-based); the actual by-level cooldown is YuumiW#AttachCooldown = byLevelL[10/10/10/10/10/5/5/5/5/5/0/0/0/0/0/0/0/0], which matches the wiki's per-level table (10 at levels 1-5, 5 at levels 6-10, 0 at levels 11+).

values.meaning: channel time before the dash begins
values.binNote: No matching data value in the sheet's YuumiW/YuumiWAttach/YuumiWCast/YuumiWEndWrapper rows; the sheet has no explicit channel-duration field for the initial cast (only recast's 0.25s cooldown appears in text), so this is sourced from the wiki description only.

mechanics.claim: While attached, Yuumi is untargetable except by turrets and inbound projectiles.
The cast is a 0.25s channel before the dash, and the ability can be recast 0.5s after attaching.
mechanics.quote: '''Yuumi''' {{tip|channels}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, then upon completion {{tip|dashes}} to the target allied champion and {{tip|Attached|attaches}} to them upon arrival, designating them as her ''Anchor''. ''You and Me!'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the attachment.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown is placed on a 5-second cooldown if Yuumi becomes immobilized, grounded, or polymorphed, otherwise it starts after completing the channel/attach.
mechanics.quote: ''You and Me!'' is placed on a {{sti|cd|5-second}} cooldown if '''Yuumi''' becomes {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|polymorph|polymorphed}}.

mechanics.claim: The Best Friend bonus's on-hit healing is affected by Yuumi's heal and shield power stat, and this bonus only applies to the designated Best Friend.
mechanics.quote: The ''Best Friend's'' healing on-hit is affected by '''Yuumi's''' heal and shield power.
